title: Real-estate developer business candidates held from owner-contact delivery
hypothesis: A public business presence can support a real-estate development-business candidate only when its development activity is specific and independently distinguished from construction, brokerage, property management, investor marketing, and software development. It cannot establish current ownership or a direct owner contact without separate evidence.
ownerSource: No developer-specific owner source is implemented. A business listing, permit applicant, officer, project representative, or investor-count result is candidate/role evidence only and cannot be treated as current beneficial ownership.
phoneSource: No catalog-verified developer-specific public business-contact endpoint is implemented. The current generic Maps fallback supplies at most a public business-listing phone candidate; it is not evidence of a mobile handset or direct owner contact.

workflow.label: Public business or activity record
workflow.detail: Read only a lawful public business presence or separately permitted public activity record; no property, residential, append, or skip-trace path.

workflow.label: Specific real-estate development signal?
workflow.detail: Require development/developer language plus a real-estate development-business or project context.

workflow.label: Hold wrong or vague cohort
workflow.detail: Hold software developers, generic builders, brokerages, property managers, investor marketing, and construction-only businesses.

workflow.label: Current owner evidence?
workflow.detail: Require independently supported current ownership; a company, officer, applicant, or representative role is not enough.

workflow.label: Hold business candidate
workflow.detail: Keep candidate/role-only records out of owner-confirmed delivery.

workflow.label: Published direct business contact?
workflow.detail: A future approved route must identify an explicitly published business contact linked to the supported owner; do not derive one from property or residential data.

workflow.label: Hold absent or indirect contact
workflow.detail: Do not use private-phone discovery, parcel records, skip trace, or an unrelated company switchboard as a substitute.

workflow.label: Contact and compliance gates
workflow.detail: Require line type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone checks.

workflow.label: Hold failed gates
workflow.detail: Hold non-mobile, unreachable, suppressed, duplicate, stale, or compliance-failed contacts.

workflow.label: Future supported delivery
workflow.detail: Deliver only a supported owner-confirmed business contact after all evidence and contact gates pass.

failures.risk: A generic listing is treated as a real-estate development business although it may be software, construction-only, brokerage, property management, or investor marketing.
failures.mitigation: Require specific development language plus a real-estate development-business/project context; hold ambiguous or excluded cohorts.

failures.risk: A listing, permit applicant, officer, or project representative is labelled the current owner.
failures.mitigation: Keep these as role or business-candidate evidence and require independent current-owner support before an owner-confirmed label.

failures.risk: The missing developer register mapping silently permits a generic Maps delivery route.
failures.mitigation: Add developer to NEVER_MAPS_DELIVERABLE so quoteJob blocks delivery until a lawful developer-specific public-business-contact route exists.

failures.risk: The NC investor-count instruction is expanded into county-owner, parcel, residential, skip-trace, append, or private-phone discovery.
failures.mitigation: Keep all property/residential/private-contact routes out of this workflow; absence of an eligible contact source is a hold.

failures.risk: A public company phone is called the owner's mobile or direct handset.
failures.mitigation: Require explicit direct-business-contact evidence plus line, reachability, DNC/TCPA, suppression, duplicate, freshness, and timezone gates.

sources.reference: src/lib/lead-engine-jobs.ts quoteJob and scrapeKeyword; src/services/lead-engine-jobs.service.ts advanceJob

sources.label: Developer-specific public business-contact source
sources.scope: A lawful source tying a real-estate development business, a current owner, and an explicitly published business contact
sources.reference: No VERIFIED developer-specific endpoint in handoff/04_SOURCE_CATALOG.md or handoff/07_RESEARCH_BUILD_SPEC.md

sources.label: NC investor-count instruction
sources.scope: Historical name-source text for investors with 6-30 properties; not a mapped register or eligible developer contact source

sources.label: Maps delivery guard
sources.scope: Existing never-Maps list controls whether quoteJob can fall back to recipe A

iterations.hypothesis: The live recipe-B developer route reads a developer name source before it can reach delivery.
iterations.test: Five-case local code audit on 2026-09-24 calling route, registerSourceFor, and quoteJob for NC real-estate developer, NC builder-developer, TX real-estate developer, FL builder-developer, and CA developer. No network, provider, credential, property/residential lookup, phone value, paid call, or personal contact data was used.
iterations.observed: All five aliases resolved to developer and brain recipe B. NC exposed only the textual investor instruction; TX, FL, and CA exposed no name source. registerSourceFor returned null in every case, and quoteJob selected recipe A with no blockers because developer is absent from NEVER_MAPS_DELIVERABLE. This measures routing only, not development-business coverage, ownership, phone type, reachability, DNC/TCPA, or delivery.
iterations.change: Treat the implementation as blocked for owner-contact delivery. Add developer to the Maps-delivery guard and hold the route until an eligible public business-contact source and owner-evidence gate are implemented; do not remediate with property or private-phone discovery.

measurement.result: Five local developer route/quote cases all had no mapped register source and fell back from brain recipe B to recipe A without blockers. Code audit only: no source rows, phone values, personal contacts, line checks, ownership checks, DNC/TCPA checks, reachability, or delivery were measured.

cost.basis: Local five-case code audit only; no provider, scrape, append, trace, phone verification, or paid step ran.
cost.note: No clean owner contact was measured. Historical developer brain figures remain under their existing Anas denominator and do not establish a per-clean cost.

implementation.summary: Developer is configured as recipe B but has no mapped register source. quoteJob therefore falls back to generic Maps discovery, which can produce a public business-listing candidate without proving real-estate development fit, current ownership, or a direct owner contact. No developer-specific public business-contact source or owner-evidence delivery gate is implemented.

nextMeasurement: After a lawful catalog-verified public business-contact source and current-owner evidence rule are implemented, run a 5-20 row aggregate source sample with separate denominators for source rows, specific development-business matches, supported owner candidates, published-business-contact candidates, line type, reachability, DNC/TCPA clearance, suppression/duplicate clearance, direct-contact support, and delivered rows. Do not use property, residential, skip-trace, append, or private-phone sources; perCleanUsd remains null until approved outcome evidence exists.
